messages.火傷を積める味方と組み、特殊火傷「黒炎」で防御レベルを下げつつ(黒炎×火傷)の傲: Pair with Burn-applying allies, then use special Burn Dark Flame to lower Defense Level and add Pride damage equal to Dark Flame × Burn. Build roughly 3–4 Magic Bullets, then use S3 Magic Bullet Fire to shoot multiple enemies together.
messages.黒炎: 特殊火傷(最大7)。数値だけ対象の防御レベルを下げ、ターン終了時に(数値: **Dark Flame**: A special Burn (up to 7). Lowers the target's Defense Level by its value, deals (value × target's Burn) Pride damage at Turn End, then disappears. S1 Ignition's Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Dark Flame next turn, and Coin Ⅱ of S1 and S2 inflicts Burn equal to the target's Dark Flame. She has no effects that increase Burn Count.
messages.S2「魔弾起爆」: Ⅰコインの的中時、魔弾が4未満なら魔弾が1増え、次のターンに: **S2 — Detonate Magic Bullet**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, if Magic Bullet is below 4, Magic Bullet increases by 1 and inflicts Dark Flame equal to Magic Bullet next turn. At 4 or more, this effect does not trigger.
messages.魔弾とS3: 魔弾は最大7。S3は攻撃前に魔弾が1増え、攻撃加重値が魔弾の値にな: **Magic Bullet and S3**: Magic Bullet has a maximum of 7. Before attacking, S3 increases Magic Bullet by 1, and its Attack Weight becomes the Magic Bullet value (multiple targets at 2 or more). The more Magic Bullet, the higher S3's Base Power and Coin Power, and on hit it inflicts Dark Flame equal to Magic Bullet next turn. At 7, it resets to 0 after the attack.
messages.精神力の代償: S3は攻撃前に(魔弾-1)×5だけ精神力が減り、精神力10以下な: **SP cost**: Before attacking, S3 lowers her SP by (Magic Bullet − 1)×5, and at 10 or less SP, there is a 50% chance it attacks without distinguishing friend from foe. The Defense skill The Price of a Bullet increases Magic Bullet by 1 (once per turn) and gains +2 Final Power per Magic Bullet, but lowers her SP by the Magic Bullet count when it ends.
messages.火傷で強化: S1は対象の火傷3につきコイン威力+1(最大3)、S2は対象の火傷: **Burn bonuses**: S1 gains +1 Coin Power per 3 Burn on the target (up to 3), S2 +1 per 6 Burn (up to 3), and S3 +1% damage per Burn on the target (up to 30%).
messages.バトルパッシブ「射手のパイプ」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): メインターゲ: **Combat passive — The Marksman's Smoking Pipe (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If the main target's Defense Level is lowered by 4 or more, she gains Poise equal to the main target's Burn before attacking (up to 20 per turn; Burn ÷ 2 at lower Uptie).
messages.火傷を付与・維持できる味方の多い編成に入れ、S1・S2で黒炎を重ねて、ターン終了: Put her in a team with many allies who can apply and maintain Burn, and stack Dark Flame with S1 and S2 to grow the Turn End Pride damage. S2 is the center of Dark Flame infliction, but it loses that effect at 4 or more Magic Bullet. S3 adds 1 Magic Bullet before attacking and only resets to 0 at 7, so landing S2 at 3 brings it to 4, and firing S3 afterward brings it to 5. From then on, S2's Dark Flame infliction stays stopped until it resets at 7, and it does not recover naturally. Aim to finish things around 3–4 Magic Bullets. The more Magic Bullet, the larger S3's SP cost and the higher the risk of friendly fire, so check her SP before firing. Building Magic Bullet all at once with the Magic Bullet E.G.O and then resetting with S3 keeps things cycling. Allies who can restore SP make her easier to handle.
